notes.title: Beads or Foam
notes.description: Two identical small red plastic shells hide beads and a silent foam ball. Shake to identify the beads, then measure mass and friction before flicking: the 0.124 kg rattler needs about 0.134 N·s to reach the nearby target.
notes.prompt: two identical red boxes, one rattles with beads, the other has a silent foam ball inside; near target, small budget
